 Sisters in festivity
 ET Bureau / Updated: Nov 7, 2026, 06:00 IST

 Print this article Reduce font size Increase font size . Actress Kareena Kapoor gave a glimpse of her Diwali celebrations with sister Karisma Kapoor . Bebo shared a special moment from the festive evening. Taking to Instagram , the ‘Jab We Met’ actress posted a picture with Karisma, offering a glimpse of their bond and festive celebrations.
Alongside the photograph, she simply wrote, “Diwali with behna.” The image featured Karisma and Kareena striking a pose together. Keeping it simple yet elegant, both twinned in yellow suits.
In the photograph, Kareena is seen looking away from the camera, while Karisma poses with her eyes closed. The ‘Udta Punjab’ actress has previously described Karisma as the anchor of the Kapoor and Pataudi families, revealing that family members often turn to her for guidance.
 .
